name: interest_mode_never
about: The interest predicate decides whether a heard sound is investigated (9, 10a). Same staging as hear_world_investigate (level 3, heard at 768 of 852 units) but investigate_mode 0: ShouldInvestigate 0x102b3270 answers false for mode 0 ('never'; conditions-and-states.md 'The interest predicate'), and the sweep 0x102b1cd0's HEAR_WORLD arm needs that predicate or a running program that already interrupts on HEAR_WORLD -- IDLE_DISPOSITION does not (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_idle_disposition.sch), nor does the Troika overlay BuildScheduleTestBits 0x102ad140 add it. So HEAR_WORLD 0x6e is raised and OnHearWorld fires (OnListened 0x1026a5e0), but INVESTIGATE_SOUND 0x25 never is; and SelectIdealState 0x102ad660 case 1 promotes on HEAR_WORLD only through HasInterruptCondition, which IDLE_DISPOSITION's mask refuses, so the NPC stays IDLE in its idle program.
known_red: N4 (inferred; V13 second wave 2026-10-04, triage 'V13 second wave, closing'): the same staging as hear_world_investigate and the same miss in the same boot -- PlaySound at 2.017, no OnHearWorld / cond+ HEAR_WORLD by 3.517 (heard at 2.833 in every suite through 20261004T082753). Intermittent, as N4 is: missed in a solo boot (20261004T093022), heard at 2.417 when run second in a boot after hear_world_investigate (20261004T093237). The arena stage stands no nav-area mark, so the V13 registration fix cannot reach it; the idle cadence has moved since suite 20261004T082753 (idle01 seqfinished 1.933 -> 1.900; V3c's closing pass landed after it, the moving change not traced), and the port's Listen drops a sound at its authored expiry (ElysiumNpcSenses.cpp ExpireTime < Now) where retail's CanHearSound 0x1030f7b0 has no expiry test. Which Listen tick misses it needs H10's think event (V10)
